mac-check.code:

brew-shellenv.code:
grep -qs 'brew shellenv' ~/.zprofile ||
  echo 'eval "$(/opt/homebrew/bin/brew shellenv)"' >> ~/.zprofile
eval "$(/opt/homebrew/bin/brew shellenv)"

which brew
brew doctor

wezterm-config.code:
[ -e ~/.wezterm.lua ] && mv ~/.wezterm.lua ~/.wezterm.lua.bak.$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)

cat > ~/.wezterm.lua <<'EOF'
local wezterm = require("wezterm")
local config = wezterm.config_builder()

config.font = wezterm.font("JetBrainsMono Nerd Font")
config.font_size = 15

-- Clean titlebar-less look that keeps the native resize border.
config.window_decorations = "RESIZE | MACOS_FORCE_ENABLE_SHADOW"

config.window_background_opacity = 0.8
config.macos_window_background_blur = 10

-- Breathing room, and an edge that is easier to aim for with the mouse.
config.window_padding = { left = 8, right = 12, top = 8, bottom = 12 }

-- Cmd-drag anywhere to move the borderless window.
config.mouse_bindings = {
  {
    event = { Drag = { streak = 1, button = "Left" } },
    mods = "CMD",
    action = wezterm.action.StartWindowDrag,
  },
}

-- coolnight
config.colors = {
  foreground = "#CBE0F0",
  background = "#011423",
  cursor_bg = "#47FF9C",
  cursor_border = "#47FF9C",
  cursor_fg = "#011423",
  selection_bg = "#033259",
  selection_fg = "#CBE0F0",
  ansi = { "#214969", "#E52E2E", "#44FFB1", "#FFE073", "#0FC5ED", "#a277ff", "#24EAF7", "#24EAF7" },
  brights = { "#214969", "#E52E2E", "#44FFB1", "#FFE073", "#A277FF", "#a277ff", "#24EAF7", "#24EAF7" },
}

return config
EOF

zshrc.code:
[ -e ~/.zshrc ] && mv ~/.zshrc ~/.zshrc.bak.$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)

cat > ~/.zshrc <<'EOF'
# SDKMAN: Java, Kotlin, Gradle, Maven
export SDKMAN_DIR="$HOME/.sdkman"
[[ -s "$SDKMAN_DIR/bin/sdkman-init.sh" ]] && source "$SDKMAN_DIR/bin/sdkman-init.sh"

# Prompt
source "$HOMEBREW_PREFIX/share/powerlevel10k/powerlevel10k.zsh-theme"
[[ -f ~/.p10k.zsh ]] && source ~/.p10k.zsh

# User-installed CLIs: pipx, Claude Code, and friends
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"

# History, shared across every open shell
HISTFILE=$HOME/.zhistory
SAVEHIST=10000
HISTSIZE=10000
setopt share_history hist_expire_dups_first hist_ignore_dups hist_verify

# Up and Down search history for what you have already typed
bindkey '^[[A' history-search-backward
bindkey '^[[B' history-search-forward

# Language managers. Each line waits quietly until step 9.
command -v fnm >/dev/null && eval "$(fnm env --use-on-cd)"
command -v pyenv >/dev/null && eval "$(pyenv init -)"
if [[ -f "$HOMEBREW_PREFIX/opt/chruby/share/chruby/chruby.sh" ]]; then
  source "$HOMEBREW_PREFIX/opt/chruby/share/chruby/chruby.sh"
  source "$HOMEBREW_PREFIX/opt/chruby/share/chruby/auto.sh"
  [[ -d ~/.rubies ]] && chruby ruby-3.4
fi

# Plugins. Order matters: syntax highlighting must load last.
source "$HOMEBREW_PREFIX/share/zsh-autosuggestions/zsh-autosuggestions.zsh"
source "$HOMEBREW_PREFIX/share/zsh-syntax-highlighting/zsh-syntax-highlighting.zsh"

export CLICOLOR=1
EOF

exec zsh -l

ssh-key.code:
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "you@example.com (macbook 2026-11)"
ssh-add --apple-use-keychain ~/.ssh/id_ed25519

cat >> ~/.ssh/config <<'EOF'
Host *
  AddKeysToAgent yes
  UseKeychain yes
  IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_ed25519
EOF
chmod 600 ~/.ssh/config

pbcopy < ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub

macos-defaults.code:
osascript -e 'tell application "System Settings" to quit'

# Keyboard: fast repeat, and no autocorrect mangling your code
defaults write NSGlobalDomain InitialKeyRepeat -int 15
defaults write NSGlobalDomain KeyRepeat -int 2
defaults write NSGlobalDomain ApplePressAndHoldEnabled -bool false
defaults write NSGlobalDomain NSAutomaticCapitalizationEnabled -bool false
defaults write NSGlobalDomain NSAutomaticDashSubstitutionEnabled -bool false
defaults write NSGlobalDomain NSAutomaticPeriodSubstitutionEnabled -bool false
defaults write NSGlobalDomain NSAutomaticQuoteSubstitutionEnabled -bool false
defaults write NSGlobalDomain NSAutomaticSpellingCorrectionEnabled -bool false

# Finder: show the truth
defaults write NSGlobalDomain AppleShowAllExtensions -bool true
defaults write com.apple.finder AppleShowAllFiles -bool true
defaults write com.apple.finder ShowPathbar -bool true
defaults write com.apple.finder ShowStatusBar -bool true
defaults write com.apple.finder _FXShowPosixPathInTitle -bool true
defaults write com.apple.finder NewWindowTarget -string "PfHm"
defaults write com.apple.finder NewWindowTargetPath -string "file://${HOME}/"
defaults write com.apple.finder FXDefaultSearchScope -string "SCcf"
defaults write com.apple.finder FXEnableExtensionChangeWarning -bool false

# No .DS_Store litter on network or USB drives
defaults write com.apple.desktopservices DSDontWriteNetworkStores -bool true
defaults write com.apple.desktopservices DSDontWriteUSBStores -bool true

# Screenshots: their own folder, PNG, no window shadow
mkdir -p "${HOME}/Pictures/Screenshots"
defaults write com.apple.screencapture location -string "${HOME}/Pictures/Screenshots"
defaults write com.apple.screencapture type -string "png"
defaults write com.apple.screencapture disable-shadow -bool true

# Spaces stay where you put them, and Mission Control hurries up
defaults write com.apple.dock mru-spaces -bool false
defaults write com.apple.dock expose-animation-duration -float 0.12

killall Finder Dock SystemUIServer

gpg-key.code:
brew install gnupg git-crypt
gpg --full-generate-key
gpg --list-secret-keys --keyid-format=long

dotfiles-repo.code:
KEY=ABCDEF1234567890   # your long key ID

mkdir -p ~/macos-env-setup/dotfiles ~/macos-env-setup/secrets
cd ~/macos-env-setup
git init
git-crypt init

printf 'secrets/** filter=git-crypt diff=git-crypt\n' > .gitattributes
git add .gitattributes
git commit -m "Encrypt everything under secrets/"
git-crypt add-gpg-user "$KEY"

cp ~/.zshrc ~/.zprofile ~/.p10k.zsh ~/.wezterm.lua ~/.gitconfig dotfiles/
cp ~/.netrc ~/.npmrc secrets/ 2>/dev/null
git add dotfiles secrets
git-crypt status

dotfiles-push.code:
git commit -m "Add dotfiles and encrypted secrets"
git remote add origin git@github.com:you/macos-env-setup.git
git push -u origin main

gpg-backup.code:
gpg --export-secret-keys --armor "$KEY" > ~/Desktop/gpg-key.asc
# Save that file to your password manager, then:
rm ~/Desktop/gpg-key.asc

next-mac.code:
brew install gnupg git-crypt
gpg --import ~/path/to/gpg-key.asc

git clone git@github.com:you/macos-env-setup.git ~/macos-env-setup
cd ~/macos-env-setup
git-crypt unlock

cp secrets/.netrc ~/.netrc && chmod 600 ~/.netrc
cp secrets/.npmrc ~/.npmrc && chmod 600 ~/.npmrc

health-check.code:
for tool in brew nvim rg tree-sitter herdr claude fnm pyenv \
  pipx chruby sdk rustc go gpg git-crypt; do
  if command -v "$tool" >/dev/null; then
    print -P "%F{green}✓%f $tool"
  else
    print -P "%F{red}✗%f $tool"
  fi
done
